entries.code: return since > 2f * gap ? float.PositiveInfinity : Math.Max(0f, gap - since);
entries.reason: Two of the shortest gaps between tankbusters on the player in this fight without one: the fight has moved on (a phase without them), and nothing is kept for one any more. One gap overdue still counts as one due now - a late tankbuster is the likelier reading. The game states no spacing of an encounter's tankbusters; the count of gaps is the rule's own threshold, its cost named in A361: after a phase change the auto-attacks meet held mitigation for at most one more gap.
